_comment: Processing methods supported by HoneyChain. The six codes are the existing ones (processing_records.method / processing_steps.method CHECK). Field limits are HoneyChain data-entry validation, not regulatory limits.

methods.label: Filtration
methods.instructions: Pass the honey through a food-grade filter and record the mesh size. Very fine filtration removes pollen that origin testing relies on.

methods.label: Straining
methods.instructions: Coarse straining through a sieve or cloth to remove wax, bee parts and debris.

methods.label: Settling
methods.instructions: Let the honey stand so air bubbles and fine wax rise to the top, then skim the surface.

methods.label: Gentle warming
methods.instructions: Warm only enough to ease handling. HoneyChain accepts at most 45 °C: heating raises HMF and reduces enzyme activity.

methods.label: Creaming
methods.instructions: Controlled crystallisation: mix in finely crystallised seed honey and stir at a cool temperature until creamy.

methods.label: Other
methods.instructions: Any other processing step. Describe exactly what was done in the details.
